about.title: About Me
description: I'm a backend developer with over five years in .NET (C# and VB.NET) and Microsoft SQL Server. Most of that work has been production software for banks, insurers, HR platforms, and government agencies: the systems and APIs those organisations rely on day to day.

At PT Xtremax Teknologi Indonesia I build backend services and REST APIs, and before that I led a small development team through whole project cycles, from technical design to deployment. Outside .NET, I build full-stack apps with React and Next.js, and I lean on an AI agentic coding workflow with Claude, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode to ship faster without losing track of the code.

I care about code that the next person can read and change without having to guess what it does. I work comfortably with distributed teams across time zones. I'm primarily looking for a full-time remote role or relocation, including with companies outside Indonesia, and I take on freelance projects alongside that.
